_help: Use this only when, in addition to the standard DDSDDE tangent, you also need
internal constitutive Jacobians and/or helper-routine output surfaces.
Fields prefixed with '_' are comments and are ignored by the loader.
This extends the minimal template with three optional blocks:
- constitutive_jacobians : extra local derivative contracts inside the UMAT.
- helper_surfaces        : map a helper routine's output to a promoted target.
See docs/contract_generalization.md for the full 'advanced' block reference.
name: my_new_umat_with_constitutive_jacobians
description: Advanced template. Edit all variable names and line numbers for your UMAT.
